title: Star Wars: A New Hope Deep Dive
description: From a desert farm to a famous farewell—Luke's first adventure in five beats.

questions.question: Luke's desert home world borrows its name from a town in Tunisia, the country where Lucas shot its desert scenes. Name the planet.
questions.explanation: The name comes from Tataouine. Luke's underground home was filmed at the Hotel Sidi Driss in Matmata, which still takes overnight guests.

questions.question: On Tatooine, the hermit Luke knows as "old Ben" turns out to be which Jedi Knight?
questions.explanation: Alec Guinness grumbled in a 1976 letter that "new rubbish dialogue reaches me every other day on wadges of pink paper." The role went on to make him rich.

questions.question: Obi-Wan hands Luke his father's "elegant weapon for a more civilized age." What is it?
questions.explanation: The prop hilt was an old Graflex press-camera flash handle. The hum? Ben Burtt mixed an idling film-projector motor with buzz picked up from a TV picture tube.

questions.question: Lightsaber packed, Luke leaves Tatooine on the ship Han Solo brags "made the Kessel Run in less than twelve parsecs." Name the ship.
questions.explanation: Pedants note a parsec measures distance, not time; Solo (2018) explained that Han took a shortcut. Lucas has said the ship's shape was inspired by a hamburger.

questions.question: Before flying the Millennium Falcon away from the Death Star fight, Han, who scoffed at "hokey religions," sends Luke off with what phrase?
questions.answer: May the Force be with you
acceptedAnswers: May the Force be with you

questions.explanation: The skeptic's blessing comes true: Han swoops back in the Falcon ("You're all clear, kid!") so Luke can take his shot. AFI ranks the line No. 8 among movie quotes.
